# Internal Documentation

Use the [internal documentation index](../../docs/internal/index.md) to place
maintainer content under architecture, governance, or development. Describe
current implementation and accepted decisions; keep proposed product behavior
in OpenSpec or `docs/product` until implemented.

When a change creates or alters a durable architecture, lifecycle, trust,
compatibility, governance, repository-convention, or recurring-workflow
decision, create an ADR rather than rewriting decision history.
